card.name: Digits inside trial result percentages
card.fires_on: Digits and decimal points in the middle of a number, usually a percentage or count/total pair, in clinical trial results comparing treatment and control groups.

modes.label: Digit in a percentage
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a percentage or fraction describing patients on a drug versus a comparator.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The decimal point inside a percentage of adverse events or deaths.

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: A digit within a dosimetry table of organ values and percentages.

card.writes: Suggests the number continues with more digits, a decimal or a closing symbol.
card.plain: It fires partway through a number in trial results, such as a percentage of patients with an event.
